Question
========
For how long may personal data be stored in identifiable form?

Answerlist
----------
* Indefinitely
* Only until the person’s decease
* No longer than necessary for the purposes of processing
* At least 10 years


Solution
========
Personal data may be stored in identifiable form no longer than necessary for the purposes of processing.

Answerlist
----------
* False
* False
* True
* False
